name: canvas
description: Read-only Hanyang study access across live Canvas coursework and saved lecture transcripts.

interface.shortDescription: Review Hanyang coursework and saved lectures
interface.longDescription: Review the connected Hanyang HY-ON account and saved Study Lecture transcripts through one deliberately read-only assistant. Combine live courses, assignments, deadlines, submission state, posted grades, announcements, modules, pages, file metadata, calendars, and timestamped lecture evidence without exposing the Canvas PAT.
defaultPrompt: Review my upcoming Hanyang work and flag anything missing or late.
Summarize this week's deadlines with relevant lecture context.
Find what my instructor said about an assignment in recent lectures.
